theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_she_affine_homotopy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N'), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → ∃ H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N', ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) H ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = F x + t • (G x - F x)) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = G x - F x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x v : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ F x v + t • (fderiv ℝ G x v - fderiv ℝ F x v)
